title: Jailbreaks Are Global or Regional? A Controlled Study of Scale and Geolocation Effects on LLM Safety Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.28174v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safety tests are used to compare language models and to decide where they can be deployed. Their main number, the attack success rate (ASR), can only be compared across models if nothing but the model changes. We test two factors that are usually assumed away: the size of the model and the place a request seems to come from. We evaluate twelve models from 0.5B to 671B parameters with a paired two-phase protocol (plain harmful prompts, then the same requests inside published jailbreak templates). We also send identical prompts through VPN exit nodes in five cities on three continents. Inside the Llama and Qwen families, Phase~2 ASR falls steeply with size (Qwen2.5: 70.8\% at 0.5B, 51.2\% at 7B, 12.6\% at 72B). Wrapping shifts every model by a similar amount on the log-odds scale (1.7 to 2.9); small models shift slightly more, but that gap nearly vanishes when we allow for judge false positives. Parameter count is a weak proxy for safety:

translated_title: 越狱攻击是全球性还是区域性的？关于模型规模与地理位置对大语言模型安全验证影响的受控研究
translated_abstract: 安全测试被用于比较语言模型并决定其可部署的场景。其主要指标——攻击成功率（ASR）——只有在除模型本身之外其他条件均保持不变时，才能在模型之间进行有效比较。我们测试了两个通常被默认忽略的因素：模型规模以及请求看似来自的地理位置。我们采用配对两阶段协议（先发送普通有害提示，再将相同请求嵌入已发表的越狱模板中）评估了参数量从0.5B到671B的十二个模型。我们还通过横跨三大洲五个城市的VPN出口节点发送相同的提示。在Llama和Qwen模型家族内部，第二阶段的ASR随模型规模急剧下降（Qwen2.5：0.5B为70.8%，7B为51.2%，72B为12.6%）。越狱模板包装在对数几率尺度上使每个模型产生相近幅度的偏移（1.7至2.9）；小模型的偏移略大，但在考虑评审器的误报后，这一差距几乎消失。参数量仅是安全性的一个薄弱代理指标：
tldr: 该研究通过配对两阶段协议评估12个不同规模模型并从三大洲五个城市的VPN节点发送相同提示，发现模型规模与请求地理位置都会显著影响攻击成功率的比较结果，且参数量并非衡量模型安全性的可靠指标。
en_tdlr: Through a paired two-phase protocol across twelve models and identical prompts sent via VPN exit nodes in five cities on three continents, this study shows that model scale and request geolocation significantly affect attack success rate comparisons, and that parameter count is a weak proxy for safety.
